title: Treasury coupon announcement (January mid-quarter block: 3-Year new issue + 10-Year and 30-Year reopenings) — the session the January auction sizes stop being inferred
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes), the four FlateDecode content streams inflated page by page and rows rebuilt from Tm coordinates. Three coupon rows carry the announcement date `Thursday, January 07, 2027`, read verbatim: `3-Year NOTE / Thursday, January 07, 2027 / Monday, January 11, 2027 / Friday, January 15, 2027` (no `R`, so a new issue), `10-Year NOTE / R / Thursday, January 07, 2027 / Tuesday, January 12, 2027 / Friday, January 15, 2027` and `30-Year BOND / R / Thursday, January 07, 2027 / Wednesday, January 13, 2027 / Friday, January 15, 2027`, against the page legend `R --denotes reopening`. The same announcement date also carries the 13-/26-week bills (auction Monday 01-11) and the 6-week bill (auction Tuesday 01-12). The ~11:00 a.m. ET announcement slot is standing convention inherited from the sibling coupon-announcement ledgers and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of treasury-10y-note-2027-01-12, 2026-09-09
notes: NAMED AND DELIBERATELY NOT FILED by treasury-10y-note-2026-12-08's initial research (2026-09-09) so a sibling could own it; this is that sibling filing it. WHY IT DESERVES ITS OWN ENTRY RATHER THAN A LINE IN THE AUCTION LEDGERS: it is the primary that settles four separately registered forward tests at once. The January 10-Year's size ($39B expected, the 24th consecutive $39B reopening since 2024-03-12), the block's Mon/Tue/Wed shape, the identity of the security being reopened, and — the number this lane cares most about — the announcement's own `SOMA Holdings Maturing on Issue Date` line all become published on this date and are inferred until it. That last field is the input to the arithmetic the 2027-01-12 ledger rests on: NY Fed SOMA holdings as of 2026-09-02 show $26.21B of TIPS maturing 2027-01-15 (912810PS1 and 912828V49), and the block splits it strictly pro-rata by offering amount, so the 10-Year's non-competitive add-on should read ~$8.6B against a ~$47.6B total accepted. NOTE THE DISTINCTION FROM THE ALREADY-TRACKED `treasury-coupon-announcement-2027-01-14`: that one announces the NEXT block (the 20-Year reopening, the 10-Year TIPS new issue and four bills, auctioning 01-19/20/21). This one announces the mid-quarter 3-/10-/30-Year block auctioning 01-11/12/13. They are different sessions announcing different securities and neither is a duplicate of the other. NAMED AND NOT FILED HERE, so a further sibling can: nothing — the January 3-Year (01-11) is proposed in the same PR and the January 30-Year (01-13) already exists as `proposals/treasury-30y-bond-2027-01-13.from-treasury-30y-bond-2026-12-10.json`. Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
